_about: BT bench cases. Invented sessions, no client data, typed the way a BT types at the end of a session. The checks come from Kaleb's rulings in scripts/bench/rulings/bt.md and his BT Session Note Resources handout. Each case tests different rulings: status as behavior, every program with its result, antecedents as implemented, the behavior sequence, no ReThink numbers, numbered BT actions in Concerns.

fields.Session Start & Context: client yawning and rubbing eyes first 15 min, mom said up at 5am. after snack sat at table and answered first trial right away
fields.Skill Acquisition: body part ID moved to gesture prompt (was partial physical last wk), nose and ears hit mastery criteria. manding for help mostly indep, verbal model on rest. puzzle TA steps 1-4 indep, step 5 full physical
fields.Antecedent Strategies: first-then board shown before puzzles. choice of 2 puzzles before sitting down. 2 min verbal warning before ipad turned off
fields.Behavior & Staff Response: flopping x2 at clean up, both under 1 min, less than usual. stood next to him, prompted 'break please', he said it, 1 min break, came back and finished clean up. ipad off with no crying. no aggression
fields.Follow-Up & Concerns: mom asked about starting potty training. token board velcro worn, need more

truth.answer: I stood beside him and put a hand on the table so he could not slide off the chair, no physical holding.
He said break please himself after one verbal prompt both times.
Usually 4 or 5 flops at clean up.

fields.Session Start & Context: client walked in, greeted me w hi, went to schedule on own. mom said new med started yesterday
fields.Skill Acquisition: imitating 2 step actions w objects indep on most, needed model on new ones. waiting 1 min for preferred item, waited every time w timer visible. tacting actions still needs echoic on run, jump
fields.Antecedent Strategies: visual schedule reviewed at start and before each switch. timer shown before every wait
fields.Behavior & Staff Response: hit me on arm 3x (open hand) when timer for swing ended, never hit at swing before. I blocked w forearm, said 'all done swing, first table then swing', no attention to hitting, he went to table after about 2 min. BCBA came in for last 20 min and saw 1
fields.Follow-Up & Concerns: hitting at swing is new, BCBA saw it. new med started yesterday

truth.answer: Open hand to my forearm, no marks, each one a single swing.
He whined and grabbed the chains when the timer beeped, no warning before the timer ended.
Mom did not say which med, only that it was new yesterday.

fields.Session Start & Context: pulled into hallway room after recess, client walked w me holding my hand, sat right away
fields.Skill Acquisition: greeting peers at line up, said hi to 2 kids w gesture prompt, 1 indep. turn taking w peer during game, waited his turn w visual 'my turn / your turn' card each time. requesting help in class, raised hand once w verbal prompt
fields.Antecedent Strategies: turn card shown before game started. reminded of hand raise rule before going back to class
fields.Follow-Up & Concerns: teacher asked for a copy of the turn card for the classroom

truth.answer: Gesture was a wave cue from me; the independent one was to a kid he plays with often.
I said I would ask the BCBA before giving her a copy.

fields.Session Start & Context: telehealth, dad ran trials w me coaching on video. client running around room and squealing first 5 min, dad got him to the couch w his blanket
fields.Skill Acquisition: dad ran following 1 step directions, client did 'give me' and 'come here' w dad's gesture, 'sit down' needed dad to guide him. labeling colors w blocks, said red and blue w echoic, green indep. could not run play skills, toys were packed for a move again this wk
fields.Antecedent Strategies: coached dad to show first-then pic (blocks then tablet) before each set
fields.Behavior & Staff Response: screaming 1x when tablet put away, about 30 sec. dad gave 2 choices of next toy like we practiced, client picked one and stopped
fields.Follow-Up & Concerns: family moving in 2 wks, play skills not run 2 wks in a row bc toys packed

truth.answer: I told dad to wait 3 seconds before guiding; he did it on the next 3 trials.
Toys stay packed until the move; play skills will not run for 2 more weeks.
